result:
`bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (12 tests, 0 failures).

I added a `published` boolean column to `posts` in `db/schema.ts` (`notNull().default(false)`, so drafts are the default and existing rows migrate cleanly) with the generated migration in `db/migrations/20260818102622_freezing_mandarin/`, applied to both the dev and test SQLite files, and made `db/seeders/002_posts.ts` insert its samples as published. `app/Models/Post.ts` gains `published` to `fillable` plus a `Post.visibleTo(viewerId)` scope — published posts OR the viewer's own, wrapped in one `where(callback)` group so later filters AND with it — which `PostController.index`, `search`, and `show` now start from (`show` uses `firstOrFail()` on that scope, so someone else's draft 404s like a missing id), and `HomeController.index` reuses for the latest-posts strip; `edit`/`update`/`destroy` keep the existing `PostPolicy` author check, so the author still reaches their own draft while others get 403. `PostResource` exposes `published: boolean` (coerced with `Boolean()` for SQLite's 0/1), `PostValidator.PostPayloadSchema` accepts an optional `published` boolean — absent means draft on create and "leave as is" on update — and the create/edit React pages (`resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx`, `Edit.tsx`) render a "Published" checkbox bound to that field. Regenerated `.guren` types, added `tests/PostDrafts.test.ts` covering guest/other-user/author visibility on the list, search, post page and edit form plus publish/unpublish round-trips, and noted the behaviour in the README.
